# Agent Cache

> Turn any documentation site into clean, agent-ready markdown docs. Paste a docs URL, get the whole site back as plain markdown files a coding agent can read.

## Product

- [Landing page](/): paste a docs URL, get an agent-ready bundle + ZIP
- [Health check (JSON)](/health): service uptime endpoint
- [Feature specs](https://github.com/agentcache/agent-cache): f01-f04 web MVP, f05-f07 CLI + MCP

## Pipeline

- Plain HTTP fetching (`.md` variant first) — no headless browser, no LLM
- Content extraction: nav/footer junk stripped, code blocks preserved
- Output: markdown tree mirroring the site, plus `_map.json` and `meta.yaml`
